items: AI reputation management matters most once you run several locations, when reviews scatter across Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor and other sites and replying by hand stops keeping up.
Look for a platform that does three things well: unifies reviews from every platform and location, responds to them at scale, and surfaces insights about operations and guest experience.
Use AI sentiment analysis to find what drives positive and negative reviews at each location, so you can fix recurring issues before they spread to other stores.
Momos brings every review into one Unified Inbox, writes on-brand replies with its AI agent Alfie, and shows guest satisfaction and incidents by location and category.
